summary: First-party executable Provider plugin for Pika API Club text and media generation.
context_hints: The plugin id is clash.pika and its Provider declaration is providers/pika.json
Media submit and poll are separate durable steps; retry scheduling belongs to the Host
Provider URLs pass through and private byte references upload through the Pika media upload API

subdirectories.providers: Pika API Club Provider declaration and secure API-key form.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, reference upload, request translation, and submit/poll adapter.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.providers/pika.json: Provider metadata and API-key authentication form.
key_files.src/pika-adapter.ts: Pika chat/media execution and durable polling translation.

quality_checks: Source typechecking uses tsconfig.check.json. Provider reference conversion rejects Host executor-url capabilities and Document references before network access.
